title: Project setup with npm and Vite

objectives.text: Scaffold a Vite project with npm and start its development server on your own machine (performed as the first step of the S27 browser-client project, reused on Fast Track FT15; rehearsed in the page's practice terminal)
Explain the roles of package.json, package-lock.json and node_modules
Distinguish dependencies from devDependencies and choose npm install or npm ci for a situation
